text: ARINC 429 BNR words shall be encoded per the ICD (label, SDI, sign, resolution, SSM, odd parity).
Small-signal step response (1 mm, unloaded) shall have rise time <= 0.15 s and overshoot <= 10 %.
Maximum rate shall be >= 35 mm/s unloaded and >= 10 mm/s at rated opposing load.
Static position accuracy shall be <= 0.10 mm and backlash <= 0.15 mm, measured at the output rod.
Position bandwidth (-3 dB) shall be >= 2.5 Hz.
At rated opposing load, small-signal step overshoot shall be <= 10 %, rise time <= 0.15 s, accuracy <= 0.10 mm.
The receiver shall reject words with bad parity.
The receiver shall treat SSM Failure Warning or No Computed Data as invalid.
The receiver shall declare a label stale if not updated within 3 nominal transmit intervals.
The receiver shall reject values outside the physical range.
With three valid sources, the voter shall output the middle value.
The voter shall fail a channel that miscompares beyond threshold for longer than the persistence time.
The voter shall not fail a channel on a single short spike.
After one channel failure, the voter shall continue on the remaining two and annunciate.
After a single-channel failure, the actuator reconfiguration transient shall overshoot <= 0.60 mm and settle within +/-0.25 mm in <= 0.80 s.
notes: RCA-001: integrator windup during rate saturation at rated load

text: The actuator command shall never exceed the position or rate limits, whatever the input.
